criterion_text: : Project-context create supports declared Existing `agent_id/path` with correct Server validation, Project default ENV inherit/explicit replace and confirmed persisted `project_id`; invalid project/location/env and ambiguous binding failure do not report an unqualified successful Project create. Managed targets, when supported by existing canonical workflow, reuse its grants/validation without fallback.

verifiers.summary: Project-context create validates through the Server, inherits or explicitly replaces Project ENV, and reports only a confirmed association
